name: Open Video Editor
tagline: Trim, rotate and resize videos on your phone
description:
Open Video Editor handles the small jobs you actually need on a phone. Cut a clip down to the part you want, rotate it, scale it, change its resolution or make it grayscale, then save the result.

It is built on Android's own Media3 libraries and Jetpack Compose, so it stays small and looks at home on a modern phone. It is also translated by volunteers into a growing list of languages.

Keep your expectations in the right place: this is a trimmer and converter, not a studio. There is no multi-track timeline, no titles and no audio editing today, though the project keeps a public roadmap of what comes next.
